subject.title: feat(memory): add excludePaths option to memorySearch config

question: Should OpenClaw ship a builtin-only public `memorySearch.excludePaths` config key now, or should this wait for a broader memory/QMD/recall eligibility design?
rationale: The code repairs are mechanical, but publishing a new config key that intentionally does not affect QMD is a product/API boundary decision.

options.title: Ship builtin-only after repairs
options.body: Repair merge semantics, index identity, and docs generation, then ship the narrow builtin backend contract with the documented QMD caveat.

options.title: Require QMD parity first
options.body: Hold this PR until QMD indexing consumes equivalent exclusion semantics and tests prove both backends behave consistently.

options.title: Fold into broader memory scope
options.body: Pause or supersede this PR in favor of the broader recall and index eligibility work tracked in the related feature issue.

recommendation.title: Ship builtin-only after repairs
recommendation.body: Repair merge semantics, index identity, and docs generation, then ship the narrow builtin backend contract with the documented QMD caveat.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this owner to the affected memory-search resolver, builtin host SDK, and published docs surfaces.
